name: How much does new drywall hanging usually cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does new drywall hanging usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing depends on room size, drywall type, ceiling height, and finish level, so the same job can vary quite a bit. A small room is usually cheaper per project than a full basement or whole-home install, and finishing work adds to the total because hanging is only one part of the job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on room size, ceiling height, drywall type, and how much finishing is needed. Small rooms cost less than basements or full-home projects, and taping and sanding add to the total.
